I implemented the Node.js CLI at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with entity schema data in [output/schemas.json](/workspace/output/schemas.json). It supports the five requested subcommands and uses only the Node.js standard library.

A Line entity smoke test passed `write`, `parse`, `roundtrip`, and `eval`; the round-tripped file was byte-identical. **This is not a complete IGES 5.3 implementation.** I have not verified lossless handling of all 87 entity types or evaluation of every listed parametric form, so it should not yet be relied on for arbitrary real-world CAD files.
